market_name: Will 8 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether 2y/5y Treasury yields are actually falling and Fed funds futures (SOFR/ZQ) are repricing dovishly; if yields flat, signal is noise.
time_plan.1h: Confirm TLT price action versus MOVE index and any Fed/newswire headlines; distinguish genuine easing bets from risk-off duration bid.
time_plan.2h: Re-check the prediction-market probability itself — has it held or reverted? Cross-reference with SOFR curve steepening/flattening.
time_plan.6h: Assess whether macro data or Fed speak is driving the move; verify TLT move is not purely rate-vol driven.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate net TLT move vs expectation; note if the dovish repricing persisted into the close or faded.

predictions.reasoning: A market implying 8 rate cuts (200bps) in 2026 is an extreme dovish/recession-or-emergency scenario. If its implied probability rose sharply, it would reflect expectations of aggressive Fed easing, which lowers the entire front-to-belly yield curve and, via lower discount rates and flight-to-quality, tends to push long-duration Treasury prices higher. TLT is the most direct liquid proxy for a large downward repricing of the policy path.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY and EURUSD reaction alongside front-end yields; confirm rate-differential story rather than broad risk-off (which can bid USD).
time_plan.1h: Watch whether risk-off dynamics override the differential effect — in a crisis-driven easing scenario USD can rally as a haven, contradicting the thesis.
time_plan.2h: Re-check prediction-market probability and USD trend consistency.
time_plan.6h: Assess relative moves in EUR, JPY, and whether ECB/BoJ repricing offsets the Fed dovishness.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate net UUP move and whether the differential channel or the haven channel dominated.

predictions.reasoning: Aggressive Fed easing expectations narrow US rate differentials versus other major central banks, which typically weakens the dollar. A sharp rise in the 8-cut probability would be consistent with lower expected US front-end yields and thus a softer USD, so UUP would tend to fall.

evidence_used: Market question implies an extreme dovish outcome of 8 x 25bp cuts (200bps) in 2026, including emergency inter-meeting cuts
Standard macro linkage: dovish Fed repricing lowers yields (bonds up) and narrows rate differentials (USD down)
Liquid ETF proxies TLT and UUP are the cleanest broadly-traded expressions of these channels
uncertainty_notes: The 700bps tradability threshold is far beyond plausible 12h moves in TLT or UUP, so neither is 'tradable' by that bar
A rise in the 8-cut probability could reflect either benign disinflation easing or crisis/emergency easing; these have opposite implications for the USD (haven bid) and equities
Prediction-market probability for such a tail outcome is thin and noisy; a move may reflect low-liquidity distortion rather than real information
Direction of asset moves depends on WHETHER the probability moved up (dovish) versus down; the card assumes a sharp upward move

llm_justification.summary: The market prices an extreme scenario of eight 25bp Fed cuts in 2026 (~200bps of easing). If its implied probability moved sharply higher, the cleanest public-market implications are lower US yields / higher long-duration Treasury prices (TLT up) and a softer US dollar (UUP down) via narrower rate differentials. Both mappings are directionally standard but weak in confidence over a 12h window, and neither approaches the 700bps tradability bar. The scenario is ambiguous because aggressive easing could be either benign (disinflation) or crisis-driven (haven USD bid), which flips some signs.
key_assumptions: A sharp move in this market means the implied probability of aggressive easing ROSE, not fell
The move reflects genuine repricing of the Fed path rather than thin-market noise
Rate-differential channel dominates over haven-flow channel for the USD
failure_modes: The scenario is already public/priced — Fed path is heavily tracked via SOFR futures, so a Polymarket move likely lags, not leads, established rates markets
Crisis-driven easing would trigger a haven USD rally (UUP up) and equity/duration cross-currents, reversing the FX call
Thin liquidity in an 8-cut tail market makes probability moves unreliable signals
12h horizon is too short for a 2026 macro theme to produce measurable, attributable asset moves
Both proxies could be dominated by unrelated same-day catalysts (CPI, payrolls, Fed speakers)
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
